question: Find the surface area of a ball of radius 21 mm. (Use π = 22/7)
solution:
**Given:**

Radius of the ball = 21 mm.

**Formula Used:**

Surface Area of a sphere = 4πr²

**Calculation:**

Using π = 22/7 and r = 21 mm

Surface Area = 4 × (22/7) × (21)²

(21)² = 441

Surface Area = 4 × (22/7) × 441

⇒ Surface Area = 4 × 22 × 63

⇒ Surface Area = 5544 mm²

**The surface area of the ball is 5544 mm².**
